nodes.label: Prior-based lens mass estimate (M_lens)
nodes.rationale: Pairs each posterior tE sample with Monte Carlo draws from assumed mu_rel (log-normal) and D_L (naive uniform line-of-sight, not a real Galactic density model) priors, since tE alone can't fix mass. Explicitly flagged as the single biggest caveat in the pipeline and only illustrative, not a real mass measurement.

nodes.label: Mass-distance-velocity degeneracy (central open question)
nodes.rationale: tE alone conflates the angular Einstein radius and relative proper motion, so it can't fix a lens mass or distance without finite-source effects, parallax, or independent proper motion -- this is exactly why brown-dwarf-mass lenses are hard to identify from microlensing alone; the whole project exists to make this degeneracy visible, not hide it behind a point estimate.
